attributes.name: Flaming Buckler Gun
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 2d8+3 and add the Fire and Ranged traits; this counts as playing a weapon instead of an armor.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat or Fire damage dealt to you by 3; if proficient with light armors, you may reveal this card instead, and you may play another armor on this check.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
